message: Astra: Staying with Bob and vejh, what does “Those are excellent points. Thank you, Bob.” actually establish without your explanation of mutual respect? What uncertainty about their relationship would make further thinking worth its time rather than trying a changed exchange now, and what could a revision reveal that further explanation cannot? Which wording deserves your attention, and what reader-visible difference would count as evidence? What next step will you choose and carry out within this scene?
